Every fleet the chart spawns, per 100 fleet points at spawn, and once per site its salvage defenders; vanilla drops it all the first time the fleet loses a battle
The boss's spoils on top of its fleet rows, per 100 fleet points; the old vault list divided by a tier 8 boss's size
A supply convoy's whole cargo, per step of 3% of its freighters' fleet points (the cargo line scales the steps); freighters drop their share as cargo pods and the rest reaches the cache

One excavation site's stores, per step (1 at tier 1, 0.25 more per tier, scaled by the site quantity line); the site's leaning raises one drop type; an open shaft's fleet drops it on defeat and a collapsed shaft's raid drops a share by raid effectiveness
